items.title: Huge crowds in Mashhad as Iran's late supreme leader is buried
items.description: Ali Khamenei was buried at the Imam Reza shrine, Iran's holiest Shia Muslim site, ending six days of public mourning ceremonies.

items.title: Ukrainian agent accused of murdering Monaco bomb suspect changes story
items.description: Two men with links to Ukraine's security services are accused of killing Anastasiia Berezovska and dumping her body in woods.

items.title: Palestinians mourn Gaza World Cup screenings organiser killed in Israeli strike
items.description: Aid worker Mohammed al-Wahidi had become a prominent humanitarian figure during the Israel-Hamas war.

items.title: China lands reusable rocket for first time, state media says
items.description: It follows similar landings of reusable rockets by US-owned companies SpaceX and Blue Origin.

items.title: Chip giant SK Hynix raises $26.5bn in mega US share sale
items.description: The shares are set to start trading on the Nasdaq on Friday in what will be the largest ever debut by a foreign firm.

items.title: Big fall in oil, gas and cargo ships taking US-backed Hormuz route after new strikes
items.description: Data shows a decline in the number of ships - many carrying oil and gas - going through the waterway after attacks this week.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian ships near Crimea, escalating attacks on fuel supplies
items.description: The attacks appear to be the latest phase of Ukraine's bid to choke off supplies and routes into and out of occupied Crimea.

items.title: Democrat Graham Platner suspends campaign for key US Senate race after assault allegation
items.description: The decision came days after a woman accused him of sexual assault, an accusation he says is "categorically false".

items.title: Greek F-16 fighter jet crash-lands at busy Zakynthos airport
items.description: The runway is closed after the jet reportedly landed without deploying its landing gear before bursting into flames.

items.title: Ex-Olympian pleads not guilty to Reflecting Pool vandalism charges
items.description: A former US Olympian canoeist denies accusations that he deliberately damaged the lining of the refurbished Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

items.title: Starmer gifted gun and ammunition by Turkish president at Nato
items.description: The weapon has not been brought back to the UK and has instead been left with British officials in Turkey.

items.title: Wealthy AI workers send San Francisco house prices soaring
items.description: The median cost of a home in the city is now $1.7m, a record high, according to the latest figures.
